nodes.name: notifications.php
nodes.summary: Client notification inbox that handles mark-all-read, single-read, single-delete and delete-all-read through GET parameters, then queries the notifications table filtered by all/unread/read and renders the list with an unread badge. Not a standalone script: it opens with requireRole('client') and depends on index.php having already loaded config.php and functions.php and defined $user.
nodes.languageNotes: State changes are done with GET redirects rather than CSRF-protected POSTs; the per-user ownership check is enforced in the WHERE clause instead (id AND user_id).

nodes.name: payments.php
nodes.summary: Client 'My Payments' page that is ~99% inline CSS plus a large vanilla-JS single-page app: it fetches settings and grouped payment lists from pages/api/client-payments.php, renders GCash and Maribank QR codes, handles deposit vs. remaining-balance payment submission, and applies the 10-booking loyalty discount. The only PHP logic is the requireRole('client') auth gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Duplicates server-side rendering helpers (fmtMoney, esc, statusBadgeJS, formatDateJS) in JavaScript; all data access is delegated to the pages/api/client-payments.php JSON endpoint rather than inline PHP queries.

nodes.name: photos.php
nodes.summary: Client photo-gallery page that lists the user's Completed bookings joined to packages with a photo count and latest upload date, then lazily loads a per-session thumbnail grid on demand. Read-only: it issues no writes and relies on the router having loaded config.php and functions.php.

nodes.name: profile.php
nodes.summary: User profile page (header comment marks it 'Shared') that processes three POST actions - update_profile, change_password and upload_avatar - re-reads the user row afterwards, and renders the profile form and avatar. Unlike the other pages in this batch it does not call requireRole(); it falls back to redirecting to login.php when $user or $role is unset, so it serves as the pages/<page>.php fallback when a role-specific profile page is missing.
nodes.languageNotes: Avatar uploads are written to a pages-scoped uploads directory rather than the UPLOAD_DIR constant defined in config.php.

nodes.name: bookings.php
nodes.summary: Admin/staff bookings management page covering the full booking lifecycle: CSRF-verified approve/complete/cancel transitions that trigger notifications and inventory deduction on completion, walk-in booking creation with checkBookingConflict() and automatic loyalty-card enrollment, plus an on-site payment modal recording deposit or remaining balance. Models a fixed 100-peso reservation fee and shows loyalty milestones (2/4/7/10 bookings).
nodes.languageNotes: Declares a file-level const RESERVATION_FEE = 100 inside the included page scope and computes a 50% loyalty discount inline in the template rather than through getLoyaltyRewards() in functions.php.

nodes.name: clients.php
nodes.summary: Staff client directory supporting a name/email LIKE search that aggregates each client's total booking count, total PAID spend and most recent booking date via LEFT JOINs against bookings and payments. Pure read-only listing page with no POST handling.
nodes.languageNotes: The LIKE clause is conditionally concatenated into the SQL string and the parameter array is built alongside it, since prepared statements cannot bind an identifier.

nodes.name: dashboard.php
nodes.summary: Admin/staff landing dashboard that aggregates booking status counts, same-day conflict detection, pending approvals, confirmed-today bookings, upcoming bookings, today's full schedule and today's walk-ins, then renders them as stat cards and lists. Chooses a 'Welcome back' vs 'Hello' greeting from the session login_count.
nodes.languageNotes: Issues seven separate unparameterized COUNT/SELECT queries per request instead of one aggregate pass; the conflicting-package logic duplicates the domain rule that checkBookingConflict() implements in functions.php.

nodes.name: feedback.php
nodes.summary: Staff feedback console that lists all client reviews joined to users, normalizes sentiment per row (preferring the stored ai_sentiment column and falling back to a local keyword analyzer), flags urgent items, and lets staff store a reply that fires addNotification() to the client. The only page in this batch that explicitly require_once's ai_helper.php, and the only one that declares PHP functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Probes the schema at runtime with SHOW COLUMNS FROM feedback LIKE ... for ai_sentiment, topics and reply_sent_at, wrapping each in try/catch and degrading to the local analyzer when a column is missing - the same ALTER-at-runtime tolerance as ensureDatabaseSchema().

nodes.name: getTopicIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a normalized feedback topic string to an emoji icon used in the review list.

nodes.name: getTopicLabel
nodes.summary: Converts a feedback topic slug into a trimmed, capitalized human-readable label.

nodes.name: getTopicColor
nodes.summary: Returns the accent color associated with a feedback topic for consistent theming across the review cards.

nodes.name: analyzeSentimentLocal
nodes.summary: Offline fallback sentiment classifier: substring-counts Tagalog and English positive/negative keyword lists in the comment and weights the numeric rating (+/-2 at 4+ and 2-), returning positive, negative or neutral. Used whenever the Gemini-backed ai_sentiment column is absent or empty.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely lexical substring matching (strpos), so no tokenizer or external service is required - it works with the Gemini integration completely unavailable.

nodes.name: getSentimentBadge
nodes.summary: Maps a sentiment value to its CSS badge class using a PHP match expression (green/red/purple, amber default).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PHP 8 match(true-style) expression semantics with a default arm, so unknown or null sentiment values fall back safely.

nodes.name: getSentimentIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the emoji glyph corresponding to a sentiment value (positive, negative, mixed, neutral).

nodes.name: getSentimentLabel
nodes.summary: Returns the capitalized display text for a sentiment value.

nodes.name: getSentimentInlineStyle
nodes.summary: Returns an inline CSS declaration overriding the badge colors, applied only to the 'mixed' sentiment; returns an empty string otherwise.

nodes.name: isUrgentFeedback
nodes.summary: Business rule that flags a review for staff escalation: honours an explicit is_urgent flag, or infers urgency from a negative sentiment, or from mixed sentiment combined with an overall rating of 3 or below.
